purpose: Recall a repeated past habit with reflection or nostalgia.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
As a child, I used to play in the river often.
In my student days, we used to talk late into the night.
I used to walk along this road every day.
restrictions: Often refers to a period well before the present and repeated activity.
mistake: A single completed event normally takes a plain past statement.
